target.outcome: Daily SUS hospital admissions among São José dos Campos residents with principal ICD-10 B34.2, by admission date
target.pollutant: Ozone, nitrogen dioxide, and PM10; lags 0-7 days
target.geography: São José dos Campos, São Paulo, Brazil (IBGE 354990)
target.effect_scale: RR per 10 ug/m3, exp(beta*10), from negative-binomial regression

substitutions.reanalysis: Public SIH-RD re-release of official DATASUS microdata
substitutions.reason: The direct FTP request timed out; the fallback preserves the same record-level outcome fields and definition.

coverage.notes: The health panel covers all 395 study days and reproduces 1,873 records. All pollutant values are missing in the independent historical response, so zero days support an exposure model.

blockers: Independent historical O3, NO2, and PM10 response contains no usable values for 2020-03-25 through 2021-04-30; the locked lagged exposure model cannot be fitted.
